title: Paul McCartney live: Adopt-A-Minefield Gala, Los Angeles | 2001
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the first annual Adopt-A-Minefield Gala at the Beverly Wilshire hotel in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 14 June 2001.

McCartney performed at the charity’s gala event each year from 2001 to 2005. Also on the bill on this night was Paul Simon.

Concert setlist

  • ‘Yesterday’
  • The Long and Winding Road
  • ‘Driving Rain’
  • ‘Jerk Of All Jerks’
  • ‘Let It Be’
  • ‘I’ve Just Seen A Face’

Adopt-A-Minefield Gala appearances

  • 14 June 2001: Beverly Wilshire, Los Angeles, USA
  • 18 September 2002: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 23 September 2003: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 October 2004: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 November 2005: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
Page last updated: 7 March 2024
